$comment: Direct dependencies approved for this repository (ADR-027). Every catalog entry and every package.json dependency needs an entry here. Adding one needs a reason, the ADR or work item that approved it, and code-owner review.

@angular-devkit/core.reason: Angular CLI toolchain peer, pinned in the catalog.

@angular-devkit/schematics.reason: Angular schematics peer of @nx/angular, pinned in the catalog.

@angular/build.reason: Angular application builder and unit-test runner.

@angular/cli.reason: Angular CLI used by @nx/angular generators and builders.

@angular/common.reason: Angular runtime for the web UI.

@angular/compiler.reason: Angular runtime for the web UI.

@angular/compiler-cli.reason: Angular ahead-of-time compiler (ngc typecheck of templates).

@angular/core.reason: Angular runtime for the web UI.

@angular/forms.reason: Angular runtime for the web UI.

@angular/language-service.reason: Angular template language service for editors.

@angular/platform-browser.reason: Angular runtime for the web UI.

@angular/router.reason: Angular runtime for the web UI.

@cloudamqp/amqp-client.reason: Second AMQP 0-9-1 client of the dual-library contract suite (DC-48); test-only shim in libs/engine/adapter-amqp091/contract, never shipped; exact pin; confined to adapter-amqp091 and apps/conformance.

@nx/angular.reason: Nx plugin for the Angular web app.

@nx/esbuild.reason: Nx esbuild executor that bundles the engine.

@nx/eslint.reason: Nx lint executor and ESLint integration.

@schematics/angular.reason: Angular schematics used by the Nx Angular generators.

@swc/helpers.reason: Runtime helpers required by Nx tooling.

@types/node.reason: Node.js types for the engine and tools.

@types/pg.reason: Type declarations for pg, used by the persistence Postgres dialect.

@types/ws.reason: Type declarations for ws, used by the live WebSocket upgrade of the transport kit.

amqplib.reason: AMQP 0-9-1 client of libs/engine/adapter-amqp091 behind the role-typed lease ports (ADR-012); exact pin, no @types/amqplib; confined to adapter-amqp091 and apps/conformance.

angular-eslint.reason: Angular template and component lint rules.

eslint-config-prettier.reason: Turns off ESLint rules that conflict with Prettier.

fast-check.reason: Property-based tests for pure and contract libraries (ObjectKey round trip).

fastify.reason: HTTP framework of the engine transport kit (ADR-004); exact pin 5.12.7 (GHSA-389g-gv7q-r4x8 fixed in 5.12.6); confined to libs/engine/transport and apps/engine.

globals.reason: Global variable sets for ESLint environments.

jsdom.reason: DOM environment for Angular unit tests.

kysely.reason: Type-safe SQL query builder over the in-repo node:sqlite dialect and pg; one migration set for both (ADR-013).

pg.reason: Postgres driver of the team-server persistence dialect (ADR-013); confined to libs/engine/persistence.

pino.reason: Structured JSON logger of the engine kernel, with path and value redaction (blueprint 13).

release-please.reason: Release PRs and changelog from Conventional Commits.

starlight-openapi.reason: Renders the OpenAPI document in the docs site.

typescript-eslint.reason: typescript-eslint flat-config entry point and strict presets.

ws.reason: WebSocket server of the live endpoint (blueprint 7.2), used with noServer on upgrade; exact pin 8.22.0; confined to libs/engine/transport and apps/engine.

yaml.reason: Parses pnpm-workspace.yaml and pnpm-lock.yaml in the supply-chain gates.

zod.reason: Schema library of @app/contracts: actions, topics, frames and the generated specs (ADR-003).
